description: This file defines the VacancyListRestController class, a REST API controller responsible for handling GET requests to retrieve a list of job vacancies. It uses various services to fetch vacancy data, applies filtering, sorting, and pagination, and normalizes the results for API responses.

classes.name: VacancyListRestController
classes.description: A REST controller that manages the retrieval of vacancy listings via GET requests and throws exceptions for other HTTP methods. Implements validation and uses dependency traits for services.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Processes GET requests to fetch paginated vacancy data, applying filters, sorting, and returning normalized results along with total count.

methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException as POST handling is not supported.
